description: This file defines a 'ProductCard' UI component using the LightningJS framework. It manages props, state, watchers, layout, and interaction logic for displaying product information such as image, name, and price.

classes.name: ProductCard
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a product card with image, name, and price, handling interactions like focus and selection.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Handles navigation to the product detail page when the component is selected.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes derived fields based on initial props and sets up watchers.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles UI changes when the component gains focus, such as highlighting.

methods.name: onUnfocus
methods.description: Handles UI cleanup when the component loses focus.
